title: Words grouped by length
summary: For each word length that appears, list the words of that length in file order.
hints: Load all the words into a growing `char **` array and find the longest length first; then one pass per length from 1 to that maximum.
In each pass print `N:` only when you find the first word of that length (a flag), then ` word` for each one, and the newline at the end of the pass if you printed something.
